sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)

Morning shift deployed; received a call from management to maintain presence at Aotea train station due to an event.
On route to location with the extra guards rostered on.
Arrived at destination, standing by for any assistance needed and maintaining presence.
Standing down from security presence at Aotea Station; commencing patrols up Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea due to the event currently happening; maintaining presence and doing a sweep around the area.
Gave directions to a member of the public searching for the event; all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Aotea — all clear; continuing patrols on Lorne St.
Welfare check Central City Library — all clear.
Welfare check Lorne St staircase mural — all clear.
Full sweep Lorne St, welfare check on all businesses open — all clear.

Welfare check Chancery Square and all businesses — all clear.
Full sweep Freyburg Pl — all clear.

Swept whole of High Street, welfare check on businesses — all clear.
Welfare check Shortland St and businesses within the area — all clear.
Welfare check Fort Lane — all clear.

Arrived at response location; asked her to vacate the premises and she fully complied; standing by until she removed all her belongings from the private site. (photo on file)
Female vagrant packed all her belongings from site; continuing patrols on Darby Street.
Welfare check Darby Street and Elliot St — all clear; patrolling up to the event for welfare checks.
Handing over to second team for patrols.
Received a call from Cotton On regarding a suspicious vagrant male inside the store.
Arrived at Cotton On store; the vagrant male had left the store.
Standing by in front of Cotton On store in case the vagrant male tried to come back.
Heading back up to Aotea Square to show presence during the event at the train station.
Handing back over to 1st team for patrols and response calls.
1st team continuing patrols up Victoria Street.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store — all clear.
Top half of Federal Street all clear; commencing sweep at St Patricks Square.
Full sweep St Patricks Square, welfare check on cathedral and businesses open in the area — all clear.
Welfare check bottom half of Federal Street — all clear.
Check-in Fanshawe St — all clear; patrolling down Customs Street to Commercial Bay.

Welfare check Commercial Bay and all businesses open within the area — all clear.
Check-in whole of Customs St, welfare check on all businesses open — all clear; patrolling down Fort St.
Welfare check Gore St / lane — all clear.

Shortland Street and businesses welfare checks — all clear; patrolling up High Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane and its businesses — all clear.
Arrived at Freyburg Pl; patrolling the area and identifying ourselves to the public.
Full sweep Freyburg Pl and Chancery Square — all clear; continuing patrols.
Whole of High Street — all clear.
Welfare check Lorne St staircase mural — all clear.
Welfare check Central City Library — all clear; arriving at Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep in the area.
Full sweep Aotea Square — all clear; patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check all businesses on Queen Street — all clear; commencing 30-minute break at headquarters.
Arrived at headquarters, commencing 30-minute break and responding to any calls that occur.
Morning shift concluded, handing over to afternoon shift.
Equipment handover: 2 x Vest, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radios, 2 x Keytags, 1 x Ops Phone.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:07)
items: Afternoon shift deployed; doing a debrief then gearing up for patrols.
Received a response call from a fellow security guard posted at Commercial Bay notifying us that JB Hi-Fi was threatened and told there would be a raid taking place; on route to location.
Arrived at response location, maintaining security presence in the area.
Guard changeover with Team 2 at Te Waihorotiu train station.
Welfare check Elliot Stables (Elliot St) — all clear.
Welfare check Darby St businesses — all clear:

Standing by on Queen St outside Ippondo, maintaining presence and on the lookout for problematic issues or vagrants; a person of interest in front of Ippondo was asked to leave the premises. (photo on file)
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding minors throwing water balloons outside their store; asked for assistance.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart; located the minors and advised them to stay away from the premises and store; they complied and walked away; standing by in case they returned.
Response call from Metropolis regarding a female vagrant passed out in a tent on their property; asked for assistance in moving her along.
Arrived at response call; advised the female vagrant she had to vacate; she was compliant; assisted her with moving belongings and tent; standing by.
Arrived at Chancery Square and Freyburg Sq, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep complete, no issues; standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants in the area.
High Street check-in — all clear; heading down to HQ to commence 2nd guard break.
Arrived at headquarters, commencing 2nd team break and responding to any active calls.
Received a call from management to make presence known at the event location; on route.
Arrived at location; notified that the event will be closing and they will need assistance getting everyone out.
Assisted at the train station event — all clear, no issues; continuing patrols up Victoria Street.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store — all clear.
Welfare check Federal Street — all clear; arriving at Federal Square.
Arrived at Federal Sq, commencing sweep in the area.
Standing down patrols; management (AJ) requested we return to headquarters to assist; on route.
Arrived at headquarters, assisting the team as needed.
Standing down security assistance at headquarters; continuing patrols down Queen Street; standing by in office for 2nd guard handover.
Received a call from management requesting we cover the Kemuri guard due to the guard being absent; on route, waiting for 2nd guard to start.
Received another call from management for the 2nd guard to start early and make way to Kemuri effective immediately.
Received a further call regarding the absent Kemuri guard handover; a fellow guard will cover Kemuri until the absent guard arrives on site.
Arrived at Kemuri; cover guard already on site; gave an introduction and assisted with support needed.
Welfare check Reign and Pour and guards — all clear.
Kemuri guard handover — all clear; heading over to Ace Karaoke Bar as requested by management.
Removed alcohol from 2 male adults — all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Ace Karaoke Bar; notified the guard that another guard will arrive; standing by and maintaining presence for any issues.
Still standing by, floating between clubs and assisting with securing entry points when the venue guards' presence is needed upstairs.
Still at Ace Karaoke, standing by until the guard arrives.
Still standing by at Ace Karaoke due to the absent guard.

sections.title: Night Shift (23:10 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Welfare check Bar101 — quick standby to show presence and ensure no issues.
Welfare check Reign and Pour — no issues; standby to show presence and await further response calls.
Welfare check Club Kong and McDonald's Britomart — heavy police presence on site, heavy presence of minors visible; no other issues to report.
Welfare check Saphires Nightclub — no issues visible; standby to show presence before moving along.
Quick welfare check Darby Street businesses — all clear; heavy presence from members of the public.
Making our way back down to Commercial Bay.
Patrolling Queen Street ensuring presence is visible.
Arrived at HQ, taking a quick restroom break before continuing patrols.
Arrived at Bar101, welfare check completed on static guards — all clear; standby to show presence and await further response calls.
Leaving standby at Bar101 due to no issues visible.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store — all clear.
Welfare check Father Teds — all clear.
Check-in Aotea Square — full scope and sweep of the area; welfare check on static guards — all clear.
Check-in top of Victoria Street; welfare check completed on all stores and businesses still open — all clear; standby to show presence and await further response calls.
Welfare check Ace Karaoke Bar — all clear.
Patrolling down Albert Street ensuring presence is visible.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, full sweep of the location; heavy presence of members of the public; quick standby to show presence.
Arrived at bottom of Fort Street — no issues; checked in on Auckland Harbour Suites — all clear.
Welfare check Fort Lane — all clear.
Patrolling up High Street; welfare check completed along Vulcan Lane — all clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square — no issues.
Welfare check Durham Street — all clear.
Ensuring presence is visible on Queen Street and patrolling the area for any possible issues.
Arrived back at HQ, commencing standby due to all clubs and businesses being closed.
No issues occurred during stand down.
Commencing patrols down Queen Street ensuring presence is visible.
Scoped out Wyndham Street — all clear.
Received a response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a large group of individuals inside the premises refusing to leave; on route to location.
Received another call from McDonald's Britomart that there was a brawl inside; running to location.
Arrived at response location; as we arrived everyone went their own ways when we showed presence; Police were called due to the seriousness of the situation.
Police arrived at the scene; pointed out the individuals involved in the assault; standing by to assist Police. (photo on file)
Standing down from Police assistance; all sorted; heading back to HQ.
Arrived at HQ; Ops Phone at 20%; continuing standby and preparing for changeover to the morning shift.
Night shift completed, handing over to morning shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Radios, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
